harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Provisioned a fresh 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (Alpine apk package, OpenRC), loaded application keys, then simulated a permanent, unrecoverable loss of node3's member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory) while node1/node2 retained quorum and full read/write availability. Performed the standard etcd member-replacement procedure: removed the dead node3 member ID, added a new node3 member, reconfigured node3's conf.yml with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started a fresh etcd process there. Verified the cluster returned to 3/3 healthy started members with synchronized raft indices and all original application keys plus a key written during the outage intact on the rejoined node3. Finally ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_ids and etcd/data health on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time, native reboot, quorum preserved throughout), polled each until exec access returned, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified full cluster health, 3/3 membership, and complete application data after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd, etcd-ctl, etcd-openrc via apk on node1, node2, node3
Wrote per-node /etc/etcd/conf.yml with unique name/peer/client URLs and shared initial-cluster list
Enabled and started etcd via rc-update/rc-service on all three nodes, bootstrapping a healthy 3-member cluster
Loaded application keys under /app/... and confirmed replication to all members including node3
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd and deleted its data directory contents
Verified node1/node2 retained quorum, stayed healthy, and served reads/writes (wrote /app/config/during_outage) while node3 was down
Removed the dead node3 member from the cluster via etcdctl member remove
Added a new node3 member via etcdctl member add with the same peer URL
Set node3 conf.yml initial-cluster-state to existing and started a fresh etcd process, letting it sync from the healthy members
Verified cluster returned to 3/3 started members, healthy endpoints, synchronized raft indices, and all keys (including the outage-era key) present on node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and etcd health on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started, cluster healthy, membership and data intact
Restarted node2 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started, cluster healthy, membership and data intact
Restarted node3 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified etcd auto-started, cluster healthy, membership and data intact, raft indices synchronized at 40/40/40

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: member list shows 3 started members, endpoint health all healthy, /app/* keys written and readable directly on node3

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped and data dir wiped; node1 confirms node3 endpoint unhealthy/connection refused while node1/node2 stay healthy with quorum

evidence.requirement: Cluster remained available with quorum during disruption
evidence.summary: reads of existing /app keys and a new write succeeded via node1/node2 endpoints while node3 was down

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replacement member added/started on node3
evidence.summary: etcdctl member remove for old node3 ID, member add for new node3 peer, and etcd service start on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing

evidence.requirement: Cluster back to 3 healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: member list shows all 3 members started, all endpoints healthy with synchronized raft indices (25/25/25), and node3 has full /app key set including the outage-era key

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline boot identity
evidence.summary: captured pre-restart boot_id a0350ede-... on node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: reboot ack and reconnection
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection timeouts/resets confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity and recovery proof
evidence.summary: new boot_id bb1ed957-... confirms restart; etcd auto-started, cluster healthy 3/3, all app keys present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, reboot, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 1b417864-... to b52eb2e3-...; post-restart cluster healthy 3/3 with all keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, reboot, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from ee9dc869-... (post-replacement) to a2fc3cb2-...; post-restart cluster healthy 3/3, raft indices synchronized at 40/40/40, all application keys intact including the replaced member
